source: User-uploaded Snow Bros-style enemy collage; all 48 individual PNG reference crops are committed under src/assets/enemies/reference/.
rules: Mappings are visual starting points only; do not rename gameplay archetypes or change AI roles.
Reference PNGs are approximate crops with original collage scenery/background retained; they are not transparent production sprites.
Do not render reference crops directly as gameplay sprites because they contain scenery and adjacent decorative objects.
Create clean transparent character cutouts and genuine idle, move, attack, hit and defeat animation frames before replacing the runtime atlas.
Keep all 45 archetypes visually distinct; do not duplicate one PNG across a region.
Bosses require separately authored larger spritesheets and must remain visually distinct from regular enemies.
Prepare five dedicated enlarged 160x160 transparent boss base cutouts from five different uploaded reference images, in addition to regular 128x128 enemy cutouts.
